turns.content: draft me a cold outreach email to a list of CEOs. i want it short, like 3 sentences, no fluff, just a clear ask.

Subject: Quick question about [Specific Pain Point]

Hi [Name], I noticed you’re scaling [Company Function] and wanted to see if you’re open to a brief conversation about how we helped similar CEOs reduce [Metric] by [X]%. Are you free for 10 minutes next Tuesday or Wednesday?
the ask is for a 20 minute intro call about our AI product.

Subject: 20-min intro to our AI product

Hi [Name], I’d love to share how our AI product helps CEOs like you [specific benefit, e.g., cut operational costs by 20%]. Are you open to a brief 20-minute intro call next week? Let me know what day works best for you.
also it needs to build rapport. mention something personal about them that shows you actually researched them. and include a story about why our product matters.

Hi [Name], I was impressed by your recent keynote on sustainable scaling—it’s rare to see such clarity on balancing growth with impact. After watching our AI cut manual reporting time by 40% for a founder facing the same bottleneck, I realized this could free up hours for you to focus on that vision. Open to a 20-minute intro next week?
also keep it 3 sentences. no exceptions.
